acceptance.check: validation with no value and no claim is refused - there is nothing to validate
a boolean masquerading as a numeric fails the syntactic stage loudly
a non-numeric value fails the syntactic stage loudly
a unit string Pint cannot parse fails the dimensional stage loudly
a value far outside its empirical range under strict=True fails the empirical stage loudly
a duration exceeding the available weeks fails the operational stage loudly

author: Cerebrum Team
description: real (clone of The_Fork app/blocks/validation_pipeline.py + config/empirical_ranges.json): runnable 5-stage validation (syntactic / dimensional / physical / empirical / operational) for numeric results, with Pint dimensional analysis and file-backed empirical ranges. Returns per-stage pass/fail plus an overall verdict so the agent can refuse to report numbers that failed validation. Envelope status is ok/failed/refused per the overall verdict - a failed validation is never returned as ok.

inputs.description: validate (default): {value, unit?, context?} or a prose claim
inputs.name: action

name: validation_pipeline_fork
